capturedContent.rawText: Pashley Grade 3 - Multiplication Facts x2, x5, x10 Name: ____________________ Date: ____________________ Unit 3: Multiplication Facts x2, x5, x10 Fluency: 5 x 2 = __ 5 x 5 = __ 5 x 10 = __ 2 x 7 = __ 10 x 4 = __ Word Problems: Mrs. K puts 5 pencils in each of 4 boxes. nodes.targetLane: skip-counting and array grouping for x2, x5, x10 facts
nodes.title: Skyglider Skip-Count Run
nodes.mechanic: tap-to-advance skip counting along a floating number path
nodes.engagementHypothesis: Reina's engagement theory shows strong positive weight for speed (5.0, confidence .875) and puzzle (5.0, confidence .92) dimensions, while her prior gearworks-crate-builder (a drag/construction mechanic) was abandoned with high frustration (0.75) whereas the fast tap-based skybird-delivery-run was completed with low frustration (0.1). This fork tests whether a low-friction rapid-tap engagement variable outperforms a slightly slower deliberate block-building/placement engagement variable, while holding academic targets, question count, and difficulty constant across both routes.
